verdict.rationale: PostHog's feature-flag docs say flags can be cleaned up from any MCP client or AI editor. That is a first-party flag-cleanup workflow, and running it from an editor points toward removing flags from code, but the mention is a single thin line. Missing for 10: stale-flag detection or reporting (e.g. flags fully rolled out or not evaluated recently), code-reference scanning that locates flag usages in the codebase, detail on how cleanup removes code, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase

citations.quote: Create, update, schedule, and clean up flags from any MCP client or AI editor.
